verses.en: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
verses.en_bbe: And Job said in answer to the Lord,

verses.en: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
verses.pt: Bem sei eu que tudo podes, e que nenhum dos teus propósitos pode ser impedido.
verses.en_web: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
verses.en_bbe: I see that you are able to do every thing, and to give effect to all your designs.

verses.en: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
verses.pt: Quem é este que sem conhecimento obscurece o conselho? por isso falei do que não entendia; coisas que para mim eram demasiado maravilhosas, e que eu não conhecia.
verses.en_web: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I did not understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.
verses.en_bbe: Who is this who makes dark the purpose of God by words without knowledge? For I have been talking without knowledge about wonders not to be searched out.

verses.en: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.pt: Ouve, pois, e eu falarei; eu te perguntarei, e tu me responderas.
verses.en_web: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to me, and I will say what is in my mind; I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.

verses.en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
verses.pt: Com os ouvidos eu ouvira falar de ti; mas agora te vêem os meus olhos.
verses.en_web: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.
verses.en_bbe: Word of you had come to my ears, but now my eye has seen you.

verses.en: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
verses.pt: Pelo que me abomino, e me arrependo no pó e na cinza.
verses.en_web: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I give witness that what I said is false, and in sorrow I take my seat in the dust.

verses.en: And it was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.
verses.pt: Sucedeu pois que, acabando o Senhor de dizer a Jó aquelas palavras, o Senhor disse a Elifaz, o temanita: A minha ira se acendeu contra ti e contra os teus dois amigos, porque não tendes falado de mim o que era reto, como o meu servo Jó.
verses.en_web: It was so, that after Yahweh had spoken these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about, after he had said these words to Job, that the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, I am very angry with you and your two friends, because you have not said what is right about me, as my servant Job has.

verses.en: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.
verses.pt: Tomai, pois, sete novilhos e sete carneiros, e ide ao meu servo Jó, e oferecei um holocausto por vós; e o meu servo Jó orará por vós; porque deveras a ele aceitarei, para que eu não vos trate conforme a vossa estultícia; porque vós não tendes falado de mim o que era reto, como o meu servo Jó.
verses.en_web: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”
verses.en_bbe: And now, take seven oxen and seven sheep, and go to my servant Job, and give a burned offering for yourselves, and my servant Job will make prayer for you, that I may not send punishment on you; because you have not said what is right about me, as my servant Job has.

verses.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job.
verses.pt: Então foram Elifaz o temanita, e Bildade o suíta, e Zofar o naamatita, e fizeram como o Senhor lhes ordenara; e o Senhor aceitou a Jó.
verses.en_web: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did what Yahweh commanded them, and Yahweh accepted Job.
verses.en_bbe: And Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite, went and did as the Lord had said. And the Lord gave ear to Job.

verses.en: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.pt: O Senhor, pois, virou o cativeiro de Jó, quando este orava pelos seus amigos; e o Senhor deu a Jó o dobro do que antes possuía.
verses.en_web: Yahweh turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord made up to Job for all his losses, after he had made prayer for his friends: and all Job had before was increased by the Lord twice as much.

verses.en: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
verses.pt: Então vieram ter com ele todos os seus irmãos, e todas as suas irmãs, e todos quantos dantes o conheceram, e comeram com ele pão em sua casa; condoeram-se dele, e o consolaram de todo o mal que o Senhor lhe havia enviado; e cada um deles lhe deu uma peça de dinheiro e um pendente de ouro.
verses.en_web: Then came there to him all his brothers, and all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that Yahweh had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.
verses.en_bbe: And all his brothers and sisters, and his friends of earlier days, came and took food with him in his house; and made clear their grief for him, and gave him comfort for all the evil which the Lord had sent on him; and they all gave him a bit of money and a gold ring.

verses.en: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
verses.pt: E assim abençoou o Senhor o último estado de Jó, mais do que o primeiro; pois Jó chegou a ter catorze mil ovelhas, seis mil camelos, mil juntas de bois e mil jumentas.
verses.en_web: So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord's blessing was greater on the end of Job's life than on its start: and so he came to have fourteen thousand sheep and goats, and six thousand camels, and two thousand oxen, and a thousand she-asses.

verses.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.pt: Também teve sete filhos e três filhas.
verses.en_web: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.en_bbe: And he had seven sons and three daughters.

verses.en: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.
verses.pt: E chamou o nome da primeira Jemima, e o nome da segunda Quezia, e o nome da terceira Quéren-Hapuque.
verses.en_web: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave the first the name of Jemimah, the second Keziah, and the third Keren-happuch;

verses.en: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
verses.pt: E em toda a terra não se acharam mulheres tão formosas como as filhas de Jó; e seu pai lhes deu herança entre seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
verses.en_bbe: And there were no women so beautiful as the daughters of Job in all the earth: and their father gave them a heritage among their brothers.

verses.en: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, even four generations.
verses.pt: Depois disto viveu Jó cento e quarenta anos, e viu seus filhos, e os filhos de seus filhos: até a quarta geração.
verses.en_web: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
verses.en_bbe: And after this Job had a hundred and forty years of life, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.

verses.en: So Job died, being old and full of days.
verses.pt: Então morreu Jó, velho e cheio de dias.
verses.en_web: So Job died, being old and full of days.
verses.en_bbe: And Job came to his end, old and full of days.
